{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.16

|gr1= Curator

|descr= Shake curator camera.

|s1= [strength,duration,area] spawn [[BIS_fnc_shakeCuratorCamera]]

|p1=strength: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0.01) shaking strength

|p2= duration: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0.7) duration in seconds

|p3= area: [[Array]] - (Optional, default <sqf inline>[]</sqf>) shake only when camera is in given distance from center. In format:<br>
0: [[Position]] - Center<br>
1: [[Number]] - Radius

|exec= spawn|r1= [[Boolean]]

|x1= <sqf>[] spawn BIS_fnc_shakeCuratorCamera;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>[0.1, 5, [BIS_explosion_center,500]] spawn BIS_fnc_shakeCuratorCamera;</sqf>
